turns.prompt_text: I’ve waited too late to go get something to eat in Ames, Iowa is there any place that still open?
turns.response_html:
While it is late, several establishments in Ames remain open to serve you.

Perfect Games This entertainment complex is very close to your current location and offers a full sports bar and pizza parlor experience.

  • Kitchen and bar stay open until 12:00 AM tonight.
  • Known for its casual environment featuring pizza, burgers, and standard bar fare.

BNC Field House - Bar & Grill Located in the Campustown area, this is one of the latest options available for food and drinks.

  • Open until 2:00 AM.
  • Provides a high-energy atmosphere popular with the local college community.

The Great Plains Sauce & Dough Co. A local staple on Main Street, this spot is perfect if you are looking for unique, thick-crust Iowa pizza.

  • Closing tonight at 11:00 PM.
  • Famous for their various crust styles and the tradition of dipping crust in honey.

Applebee's Grill + Bar For a reliable late-night menu of American classics, this chain is open for another hour.

  • Open until 11:00 PM tonight.
  • Full menu available including appetizers, burgers, and pasta.

turns.prompt_text: Do we have any kiwi trips in Ames?
turns.response_html:
If you are looking for Kwik Trip (which is actually called Kwik Star here in Iowa), you are in luck. In Ames, there are several locations that are open 24 hours a day, making them the perfect "late late" option for food when everywhere else is closed.

They have a solid selection of hot food like pizza, burgers, and fried chicken, even in the middle of the night. Here are the spots in town:

Kwik Star Locations (Ames)

  • Kwik Star #1158: Located at 1900 Isaac Newton Dr (South Ames, near the airport).
  • Kwik Star #1162: Located at 210 Lincoln Way (Near the downtown/Ames High area).
  • Kwik Star #1163: Located at 1511 Buckeye Ave (Just off I-35).

Since you mentioned "kiwi trips," it’s a common mix-up—just remember that in Iowa, they use the name Kwik Star to avoid confusion with the QuikTrip (QT) chain found in other states.

Were you looking for a specific item from their "Hot Spot" menu, like their Glazers or a slice of pizza?
